'''Helik''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] from [[Aquella]]. His [[King/Legends|King]] [[Lorro]] was one of several heads of state summoned by the Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] to a diplomatic summit on [[Outpost 256]], where Rakton seized the heads of state by force. Helik managed to contact the Republic for help and he and the others were rescued from Rakton's forces by [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="TOR" />
